name: store-contextual-v1
description: 30 memories of a second made-up household (Maya Chen and Luis Ortega) in three sessions, with 10 questions. Seven of the questions have an answer in a memory that names neither person nor topic (the budget, the wood, where they cook, the choir's piece, the ticket price, and two corrected dates); two are controls whose memory shares words with the question. It checks that a lift measured on the store-v1 fixture is not the fixture's.

memories.content: Maya Chen and Luis Ortega are renovating the kitchen of their house in Portland, Oregon.
The budget is 32,000 USD with a 10 percent reserve.
Work starts on 2027-01-11 and the contractor expects eight weeks.
Correction: the start moved from 2027-01-11 to 2027-02-08 because the city permit was late.
They chose white oak and dropped walnut because it cost 4,000 USD more.
The contractor is Ben Alvarez of Alvarez Build. His crew is four people.
Luis wants an induction cooktop. Maya prefers gas.
They agreed on induction after the electrician confirmed the panel can take it.
The dishwasher is a 24 inch model from Bosch and arrives on 2027-03-01.
The demolition dumpster must be booked a week ahead and the city permit costs 380 USD.
The floor is 12 by 24 inch matte gray porcelain tile.
They will use a hot plate in the garage and eat out for the eight weeks.
Maya's brother Tomas offered to help with painting on the weekend of 2027-03-20.
Maya Chen is a veterinary technician at Cedar Animal Hospital.
She works Tuesday to Saturday, 8 am to 4 pm.
Her supervisor is Dr. Rosa Imani.
She is studying for the dentistry specialty exam on 2027-05-14.
The clinic switched to a new records system called ClinicFlow in September.
The exam fee is 450 USD and the clinic reimburses half.
Correction: the exam moved from 2027-05-14 to 2027-06-11 because the testing center closed.
Noor agreed to take the Friday shift in March.
Luis Ortega sings bass in the Willamette Community Choir.
Rehearsals are Monday evenings at 7 pm in the church hall.
The spring concert is on 2027-04-17.
They are performing Faure's Requiem and two folk arrangements.
The director asked for tenors to arrive 15 minutes early.
Luis is allergic to penicillin.
Tickets cost 18 USD and Maya has bought four for her family.
Luis runs the 5 km Saturday parkrun in Laurelhurst Park.
He wants to be under 24 minutes by June. His best time so far is 25:40.
